name: Berri
description: Berri was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was a hot, smog-shrouded world with high gravity and a dense atmosphere. It was the homeworld of the Berrite species, which evolved to become master foragers due to its few natural food sources. There was a lack of galactic trade with Berri, and its inhabitants cultivated a heavy, hand-crafted industry that harnessed power from natural geothermic energies.
